question: Are the vehicles automatic or manual? And do they have AC?
answer: All our vehicles have automatic transmissions provided with full air-conditioning and a Bluetooth connection system.

question: Are there any additional fees when renting a car?
answer: You can relax and be certain that there are no hidden fees when renting a car at Dushi Rentals Curaçao. The prices include third-party insurance. Taxes (9%) are charged at checkout — no further additional fees.

question: Can I get my rental delivered at the Curaçao Airport?
answer: Yes, we offer FREE drop-off and pick-up at the Curaçao Airport. After completing your reservation you will receive an instruction document on where to meet our representative who will have your rental ready.

question: What do I need to rent a car?
answer: Each person who intends to drive must bring a valid driver's license and a valid means of payment (generally via credit card). All items must be submitted on the day the car will be picked up.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: Dushi Rentals Curaçao accepts credit cards such as Visa, Maestro and American Express. If "Pay later" is selected, we also accept cash on delivery.

question: What insurance is included?
answer: All vehicles include basic third-party insurance. You can also opt for additional coverage: Premium Protection ($19/day, $0 responsibility), Intermediate Protection ($10/day, $400 responsibility), or Standard Protection ($6/day, $850 responsibility).

question: What is the minimum rental period?
answer: The minimum rental period at Dushi Rentals Curaçao is four days. There is no maximum — rent for as long as you need!

question: Can I cancel or modify my reservation?
answer: Yes, you can cancel your reservation per our terms & conditions. For modifications, please email us at info@dushirentalscuracao.com with your changes.
